context.purpose: Check saved Premiere sequence source identities and complete named video track layouts, with exact frame range coverage requirements. Read-only; native qualification pending.
context.assumptions: Windows/macOS host, Premiere 26.5+, UDT 2.2+, supplied panel loaded in developer mode, exact native project/source paths and an idle active sequence. Local private bridge folder.
context.constraints: sequenceContract: one contiguous video track. sequenceLayout: complete ordered 1..8 uniquely named video tracks, gaps/overlays/empty tracks, 1..128 total clips, 1..600 frames and 0..32 coverage requirements. Integer 24/25/30/50/60 fps, zero sequence start. All tracks unmuted and clips enabled; empty audio tracks, no captions/transitions/adjustment/reversed/offline/nested/merged/multicam/proxy clips. Source/rendered bytes, opacity, effects and intermediate time remapping are not checked.
context.inspection: Compare exact native ticks, ordered source identities, project/sequence GUIDs, dimensions and runtime identity. Two complete matching observations detect observed concurrent edits without claiming atomicity. For sequenceLayout, independently reconstruct observed frame occupancy, per-track gaps and named minimum-active-track coverage decisions.
context.recovery: NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_UNAVAILABLE on Linux is expected. BRIDGE_NOT_CONFIGURED requires --premiere-bridge. RUNNER_TIMED_OUT needs a fresh attempt and explicit panel folder selection. CONTRACT_MISMATCH needs matching native sequence structure. No native action is performed to repair the project. INVALID_LAYOUT needs ordered non-overlapping positive clip ranges within endFrame. REQUIREMENT_FAILED retains layout.json with uncovered frame numbers; revise the intended requirement or manually repair the native timeline, then use a fresh attempt.

lifecycle.timeout: A shared elapsed deadline bounds human panel selection, observation arrival and final host verification; panel checks expiry before publishing.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared cancellation ends the bounded wait; no native application process is started or killed. Expired jobs cannot publish accepted results.
lifecycle.logs: Retain authored/plan/request/response/observation, per-attempt nonce and bridge-job path, structured failed result and final verification. No fictitious native process log.
lifecycle.verification: Closed bounded native observation checks exact ticks and source identities against an independent authored plan; request hash/nonce prevent stale attempts. Two complete matching observations, native runtime/project identities and retained byte hashes. Source contents, effects and export are unverified; local wholesale evidence fabrication is outside the trust model. Layout reports are regenerated from exact observed ticks using a bounded occupancy grid; missing, changed or failed reports cannot verify.
